query:
UPDATE accounts
                  SET acct_active_status     = $2,
                      acct_curr_bal          = $3,
                      acct_credit_limit      = $4,
                      acct_cash_credit_limit = $5,
                      acct_open_date         = $6,
                      acct_expiraion_date    = $7,
                      acct_reissue_date      = $8,
                      acct_curr_cyc_credit   = $9,
                      acct_curr_cyc_debit    = $10,
                      acct_addr_zip          = $11,
                      acct_group_id          = $12
                WHERE account_id = $1
